Typed 10-operator algebra
Every weight-space edit executes exclusively through `WSE-OP01..10` with declared domain, units, norm preconditions, and ATP cost.
items.category: L7_WSE12 / WSE-12 Weight-Space Editing / Direct Weight-Space Editing
items.criterion:
